name: global_totals
query: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(balance), AVG(balance), MIN(balance), MAX(balance) FROM accounts

name: category_breakdown
query: SELECT category, COUNT(*), SUM(balance) FROM accounts GROUP BY category

name: status_counts
query: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM accounts GROUP BY status

name: active_premium_totals
query: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(balance) FROM accounts WHERE category = 'premium' AND status = 'active'
